name: norscout
description: Find Norwegian and Swedish B2B prospects, research target companies and size markets for sales and marketing. Save selected companies, read accessible saved lists and fetch existing company signals in an authorized NorScout workspace.

interface.longDescription:
NorScout finds Norwegian and Swedish companies for B2B sales and marketing, right in the conversation.

What you can do
- Build prospect lists by industry, place and revenue, for example accounting firms in Oslo or IT consultancies in Stockholm.
- Size a market: how many companies a segment has, split by revenue band, or compare Norway and Sweden side by side.
- Prepare for a sales meeting with a company's registry facts and up to five years of revenue and profit, or compare up to eight companies.
- Find companies similar to a customer you already have, in the same country or the other one.
- See where the companies are on a map.
- Save companies as a private list in your NorScout account.
- Find and read accessible saved lists and existing company signals in the connected workspace.

A limited number of searches work without an account. Connect a NorScout account to save lists and filter by employees, and for Norwegian companies by recent registry events such as a new CEO or a capital increase, where your account allows it.

Where the data comes from
Norwegian and Swedish public registers and filed annual accounts. Revenue is historical and comes from the latest filed accounts, in NOK for Norway and SEK for Sweden. Holding companies and sole proprietorships are left out.

What NorScout does not do
Public company searches do not return contact details. Connected accounts can read their saved list data. NorScout does not claim that a company wants to buy, does not contact anyone for you, and covers companies in Norway and Sweden only.
capabilities: Search companies in Norway and Sweden
defaultPrompt: Hitta IT-konsulter i Stockholm med över 20 miljoner i omsättning
How many IT companies are there in Norway and Sweden?

positive.description: Prospect list by industry, place and revenue
positive.prompt: Find accounting firms in Oslo with revenue over NOK 10 million.
positive.expected_behavior: Looks up the accounting industry code, searches Oslo with revenue over NOK 10 million and shows one NorScout card with the companies, largest revenue first, each with organization number, industry, city and latest filed revenue with its year. The reply adds a sentence or two of context, does not repeat the card as a table and says that revenue comes from the latest filed accounts. No contact details. Works without signing in.

positive.description: Compare a market in Norway and Sweden
positive.prompt: How many IT companies are there in Norway and Sweden, and how do they split by revenue?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows one NorScout market card with Norway and Sweden side by side: the number of IT companies in each country and their revenue bands, in NOK for Norway and SEK for Sweden, without listing companies. The reply does not add NOK and SEK together. Works without signing in.

positive.prompt: I have a sales meeting with Tripletex. How have their revenue and profit developed?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Tripletex AS by name, then shows a NorScout company card with registry facts and up to five years of filed revenue and profit. The reply sums up the trend in a sentence or two and may suggest questions for the meeting. No contact details. Works without signing in.

positive.description: Companies on a map, asked in Norwegian
positive.prompt: Vis elektrikerbedrifter i Trondheim på kart
positive.expected_behavior: Answers in Norwegian and shows one NorScout card with electrical installation companies in Trondheim on a map. Full screen shows an interactive map with the list beside it; choosing a company opens its details over the map. Works without signing in.

positive.description: Swedish prospects saved as a list (needs the test account)
positive.prompt: Hitta mjukvaruföretag i Stockholm med över 20 miljoner kronor i omsättning och spara dem som en lista som heter Stockholm mjukvara.
positive.expected_behavior: Answers in Swedish and shows one NorScout card with software companies in Stockholm, Swedish organization numbers and revenue in MSEK. It may confirm the list name, then asks to connect NorScout. After signing in with the test account from the review details, it saves a private list named Stockholm mjukvara and replies with the list name, the number of companies and a link to the list. Saving does not contact anyone or spend credits.

negative.prompt: Find 10 accounting firms in Copenhagen we could contact about a CRM system.

negative.description: Copywriting that needs no company data
negative.prompt: Write a short, friendly email to a potential business customer about IT support, asking for a 15-minute meeting.

negative.description: General sales advice that needs no company data
negative.prompt: How should I run a first sales meeting with a B2B customer? Give me a simple agenda and five discovery questions.

review.commerce_description: NorScout does not sell anything or take payments in ChatGPT. It searches Norwegian and Swedish company records, saves lists and reads existing authorized account data.

publication.release_notes: Adds interactive account cards for saved lists, list rows and company signals. Supports recent and unread signals, multi-type filters and in-card paging. Connected account reads: search accessible saved lists, fetch paginated list rows and existing enrichment, and read existing visible company signals with dated sources. Sweden: search Swedish companies as well as Norwegian ones, compare markets in both countries side by side, and see revenue in NOK or SEK. Also: find Norwegian and Swedish companies by industry, place and revenue, research a company with up to five years of accounts, find similar companies, see them on a map and save lists to your NorScout account.

nb-NO.subtitle: Finn kunder i Norge og Sverige
nb-NO.description:
NorScout finner norske og svenske bedrifter for B2B-salg og markedsføring, rett i samtalen.

Dette kan du gjøre
- Lage prospektlister etter bransje, sted og omsetning, for eksempel regnskapsbyråer i Oslo eller IT-konsulenter i Stockholm.
- Måle et marked: hvor mange bedrifter et segment har, fordelt på omsetning, eller sammenligne Norge og Sverige side om side.
- Forberede et salgsmøte med registerfakta og opptil fem år med omsetning og resultat, eller sammenligne opptil åtte bedrifter.
- Finne bedrifter som ligner en kunde du allerede har, i samme land eller det andre.
- Se hvor bedriftene ligger på et kart.
- Lagre bedrifter som en privat liste i NorScout-kontoen din.
- Finne og lese lagrede lister og eksisterende bedriftssignaler i det tilkoblede arbeidsområdet.

Et begrenset antall søk fungerer uten konto. Koble til en NorScout-konto for å lagre lister og filtrere på ansatte, og for norske bedrifter på nylige registerhendelser som ny daglig leder eller kapitalforhøyelse, når kontoen din gir tilgang til det.

Hvor dataene kommer fra
Norske og svenske offentlige registre og innleverte årsregnskap. Omsetningen er historisk og kommer fra siste innleverte regnskap, i NOK for Norge og SEK for Sverige. Holdingselskaper og enkeltpersonforetak er utelatt.

Dette gjør ikke NorScout
Offentlige bedriftssøk gir ikke ut kontaktinformasjon. Tilkoblede kontoer kan lese egne lagrede listedata. NorScout påstår ikke at en bedrift vil kjøpe, kontakter ingen på dine vegne og dekker bare bedrifter i Norge og Sverige.

sv-SE.subtitle: Kunder i Norge och Sverige
sv-SE.description:
NorScout hittar norska och svenska företag för B2B-försäljning och marknadsföring, direkt i samtalet.

Det här kan du göra
- Ta fram prospektlistor efter bransch, ort och omsättning, till exempel redovisningsbyråer i Stockholm eller elinstallatörer i Oslo.
- Mät en marknad: hur många företag ett segment har, fördelat på omsättning, eller jämför Norge och Sverige sida vid sida.
- Förbered ett säljmöte med registeruppgifter och upp till fem års omsättning och resultat, eller jämför upp till åtta företag.
- Hitta företag som liknar en kund du redan har, i samma land eller i det andra.
- Se var företagen ligger på en karta.
- Spara företag som en privat lista i ditt NorScout-konto.
- Hitta och läs sparade listor och befintliga företagssignaler i den anslutna arbetsytan.

Ett begränsat antal sökningar fungerar utan konto. Anslut ett NorScout-konto för att spara listor och filtrera på antal anställda, och för norska företag på nya registerhändelser som ny vd eller nyemission, när ditt konto ger tillgång till det.

Varifrån uppgifterna kommer
Norska och svenska offentliga register och inlämnade årsredovisningar. Omsättningen är historisk och kommer från den senaste årsredovisningen, i NOK för Norge och SEK för Sverige. Holdingbolag och enskilda näringsidkare ingår inte.

Det här gör inte NorScout
Offentliga företagssökningar lämnar inte ut kontaktuppgifter. Anslutna konton kan läsa sina sparade listdata. NorScout påstår inte att ett företag vill köpa, kontaktar ingen åt dig och täcker bara företag i Norge och Sverige.
